title: Anime 134 · 콜로설 · 탈라베라 · 정면
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation illustration, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

Style: A high-quality Japanese anime key visual illustration, clean cel shading, crisp confident line art, vibrant saturated colors, polished professional anime art — not a photograph.

Subject: ONE mature adult Black woman in her early 40s with clearly adult facial features, a voluminous curly half-up half-down style, a serene regal expression. She wears long geometric drop earrings and has oval nails with a satin finish.

Physique: Deep near-black skin tone, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, void complexion, not brown, not blue, not lightened, her face exactly as dark as her body. EXTREME COLOSSAL PHYSIQUE THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE, exaggerated far beyond real anatomy, around 1,000 pounds — a giantess built on a completely even scale, every part of her enlarged by the same amount: massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full bust, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, enormous columnar thighs and thick heavy calves, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her shoulders span more than four head-widths. No single part stands out more than another, no hanging rolls and no folds, not pregnant, her whole body scaled up together into one immense smooth silhouette that towers over the viewer. Her body fills the full width of the frame.

Body Art: Full body Mexican Talavera ceramic body painting on her bare skin from the collarbones to the ankles, a glossy white tin glaze covering her entire body, painted with bold cobalt blue, marigold yellow, terracotta orange and green floral rosettes, star medallions and scalloped borders, a thick cobalt border following every deep crease and curve. The pattern covers the entire bust densely with no open gaps, and wraps fully around the rear, the lower belly, the knees and the calves, covering them as densely as the chest.

Pose: Standing upright full frontal with her feet planted apart, arms hanging relaxed away from the body, her full immense silhouette clear against the background, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme marigold-yellow platform stiletto sandals laced around the ankle, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: A dark midnight-blue stylized background, a single strong warm light from one side, broad sweeping shadows across the great curves of the torso, hips and thighs showing their scale, the cobalt and marigold blazing on the white glaze, glossy anime highlights on every curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body illustration, taller than it is wide.
